        return True
    if k > n:
        return False
    adj = [0] * n
    for u, v in inst["edges"]:
        adj[u] |= 1 << v
        adj[v] |= 1 << u

    # Find maximum clique size via simple recursive search.
    best = 0

    def expand(cand, size):

            return
        if cand == 0:

                best = size
            return
        while cand:

                return
            v = (cand & -cand).bit_length() - 1
            cand &= ~(1 << v)
            expand(cand & adj[v], size + 1)
            if best >= k:
                return

    expand((1 << n) - 1, 0)
    return best >= k
